# `aitbc compliance check`

Check whether a data classification is allowed by a compliance policy.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc compliance check [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--framework` | text | `hipaa` | no | Compliance framework to check against |
| `--classification` | text | `phi` | no | Data classification label |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc compliance check
```
